keywords: Verification process 2.Problem-solving process 3.Basic skills 4.Data handling skills 5.PBL for science and technology
educationalGoal: ・To gain the basic skills needed in processes from finding problems to solutions. ・To understand phenomena, objects, and events quantitatively and qualitatively. ・To be able to find characteristics and laws of phenomena, objects, and events. ・To be able to deliver the above information to a third person intelligibly. ・To gain various basic skills needed to proceed smoothly with verification activities.
advice: In this course, to achieve the above educational goals, the students will learn the basic skills required for verification and problem-solving processes. This course will deal with characteristic things of the corresponding department. One is that the students will learn the basic “data-handling skills” needed for data collection → organization → analysis→ hypothesis testing→ visualization → reporting. One is that the students will learn the basic skills of “PBL for science and technology” including the basic elements of processes from problem-finding to solution and verification activities. For “data-handling skills”, conduct a compressive strength test of mortar and conduct ground liquefaction experiments. For “PBL for science and technology”, we will work on the production of high-strength mortar and a ground model where liquefaction is active. The course focuses on the following two points. (1) Think and actively engage in team activities while receiving instruction from a teacher. (2) Plan and carry out experiments and verification activities according to the purpose, while giving consideration to safety and health.
books: 土木材料、地盤工学に関する図書
requiredKnowledge: Basic knowledge of mathematics, physics, safety, and health learned in higher education.

activityGoals.body: To be able to proceed with activities from finding problems to solutions.
To be able to understand phenomena, objects, and events quantitatively and qualitatively
To be able to find characteristics, features, and laws of phenomena, objects, and events
To be able to deliver acquired information to a third person intelligibly.
To be able to utilize various basic skills needed to proceed smoothly with verification activities.
To be able to have a picture of the technology fields and engineers in the discipline.
